place_fields.summary: Kittur Rani Channamma Nisargadhama is a mini zoo in Bhutaramanahatti near Belagavi, with animal enclosures, visitor trails and conservation-focused facilities.
place_fields.best_time: Morning is suitable for a full visit; the zoo advises early morning or evening for visitors focusing on big cats.

planning_attributes.description: A wildlife-oriented visitor attraction operated under the Zoo Authority of Karnataka, with animal enclosures, trails and visitor amenities.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Established in 1989 at Bhutaramanahatti and later developed as Kittur Rani Channamma Nisargadhama Mini Zoo.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Kittur Rani Channamma Nisargadhama at Bhutaramanahatti, Belagavi, Karnataka.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Tuesday is the weekly holiday; zoo visiting hours are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow zoo visitor rules and remain within designated visitor areas.
planning_attributes.notes: Visitor amenities include drinking water, rest rooms, benches and wheelchair access.

place_fields.summary: Bhimgad Adventure Camp is a Jungle Lodges property offering an outdoor stay with guided nature activities and access to nearby forest and heritage experiences.

planning_attributes.description: A nature-oriented camp with guided nature walks and outdoor activities; the published itinerary includes a Rajhansgad Fort visit and a two-hour nature walk.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The supplied listing places the camp opposite Belgaum Golf Course on Katgali Road, Desur; Jungle Lodges identifies the property in the Belagavi area.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The published stay itinerary has check-in at 1:00 PM and check-out at 10:30 AM; accommodation tariffs are per person per night on twin sharing.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The operator recommends comfortable walking shoes and outdoor essentials for time spent outdoors.
local_name_variants: Bhimgad Adventure Camp by Jungle Lodges
planning_attributes.notes: Published activities include guided nature walks and a Rajhansgad Fort excursion; the nature walk is scheduled from 6:30 AM to 8:30 AM in the published itinerary.

place_fields.summary: Tiger Safari is the safari attraction at Kittur Rani Channamma Mini Zoo in Bhutaramanahatti, Belagavi, where visitors view tigers from the safari vehicle.
place_fields.best_time: Morning is preferable for wildlife viewing, while the zoo notes that big cats tend to rest during the day.

planning_attributes.description: A tiger-focused safari attraction associated with Kittur Rani Channamma Mini Zoo at Bhutaramanahatti.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The tiger safari was opened at the Kittur Rani Channamma Mini Zoo in December 2022 as a wildlife-viewing attraction.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Kittur Rani Channamma Nisargadhama at Bhutaramanahatti, Belagavi, Karnataka.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The safari is within the zoo visitor facility; zoo hours are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM and Tuesday is the weekly holiday.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Visitors must remain inside the safari vehicle and must not put hands outside, get down, shout, scream or wave at the big cats.
local_name_variants: Kittur Rani Channamma Mini Zoo Tiger Safari
planning_attributes.notes: The safari is located within the Kittur Rani Channamma Mini Zoo complex.
